description: The Promenade de la Treille runs along Geneva's old rampart above Parc des Bastions, a walk of horse-chestnut trees and one long wooden bench. This replaces Place du Bourg-de-Four, already published as the old-town square. The cathedral front is not the subject. The Open-Meteo model is overcast and mild, about 19°C, with little wind and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
